player_intent: Match decoded native animation periods and the original grounded idle blend curve in the playable game.
acceptance_rule: Intact source loops consume verified reader periods through AnimationTree custom timelines without changing source files. Rifle idle is6 seconds, crouch5, pistol idle5. Source-grounded rifle idle arrivals use quadratic ease-in/out. Actions, held clips and source jump windows retain their existing clocks; old presets opt out. This is period and curve parity, not frozen outgoing pose or universal source-selection parity.

nodes.role: Sole animation graph consumes source timing after authoritative movement input

visual_check: Native main movement-to-idle early/middle/late snapshots with current skinned character; fire and reload return. Source curve alone must not be claimed a frozen outgoing pose.

system_delta.reason: Pinned original instruction fixtures establish reader periods and quadratic weights. Configure existing AnimationTree resources; no new clock or Skeleton writer.

current.system: Raw-duration source loops and linear fades

candidate.system: Decoded loop periods and curve in canonical graph
